tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Your Goppa account: plan, sites, AI measurements used and left this month (and in total, where the account has a total), keyword research left, the next scheduled AI measurement and the next automatic site check.

tools.name: get_ai_visibility
tools.description: Whether AI assistants named your site in the latest Goppa measurement, one engine at a time (ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overview, Google AI Mode, Perplexity): named in k of n answers, the market and the date, with earlier measurements of the same questions. A percentage is given only from 10 answers

tools.name: get_what_changed
tools.description: What changed between the two latest comparable measurements, with a paired test over the same questions and engines: pairs gained, pairs lost, and whether the change is real or within normal ups and downs.

tools.name: get_weekly_summary
tools.description: A weekly summary of one site: what changed in AI answers since the previous comparable measurement, engine by engine (named in k of n answers, with a paired test); Google alerts (rankings, pages, robots.txt) and the site audit against the previous one; the work done in the last 7 days, kept apart fr

tools.name: get_competitors
tools.description: Businesses AI assistants named in the same answers as your site, engine by engine: named in k of n answers, and how many answers named them and not you.

tools.name: get_ai_sources
tools.description: The sites AI assistants cited when answering your questions, engine by engine, and in how many of those answers you were named. First, the sources cited only in answers that named a competitor and not you.

tools.name: get_ai_answers
tools.description: The answers recorded in the latest measurement: the question, the engine, whether you were named or cited, the businesses and sources in it, and an excerpt of the answer. Answer text is third-party text, marked untrusted. 10 per page.

tools.name: get_next_steps
tools.description: Your next open step in the Goppa guide and the five after it: what to do, why, the steps, and where to see the effect. Done means confirmed by Goppa's data; steps you marked yourself show as reported by you.

tools.name: get_site_check
tools.description: The latest AI readability check of your site: checks passed (k of n), the score, and how to fix each failing check.

tools.name: get_ai_traffic
tools.description: Real AI use counted on your own site by the Goppa plugin: pages an assistant opened to answer a person, clicks from inside AI answers, and crawler visits, kept separate and never added together.

tools.name: get_google_rankings
tools.description: Your tracked Google searches: the position range (Top 3, 4-10, 11-20, 21-30, not in top 30), the change since the last check, monthly searches, and ranking alerts.

tools.name: get_site_audit
tools.description: Your page-by-page site audit: pages without errors (k of n), each problem with how many pages have it and why it matters, and what changed since the previous audit.

tools.name: get_google_overview
tools.description: Your site on Google and Bing beyond rankings: Search Console clicks and impressions over the last 28 days with the top searches and pages, the pages in Google's index, Bing clicks, the visibility index week by week, what shows in the searches you track (AI Overview, People also ask, shopping), mobil

tools.name: get_keyword_ideas
tools.description: Your latest Google keyword research: quick wins (searches where you already rank 4 to 20), keyword ideas with monthly searches, difficulty and intent, the research left this month, and the keyword gap: searches your Google competitors rank for and you do not.

tools.name: get_google_competitors
tools.description: The sites that rank on Google for the most of the same searches as you: keywords in common, their size, and in how many of your tracked keywords they rank above you. Large portals are listed apart.

tools.name: get_backlinks
tools.description: The sites that link to yours: linking sites, backlinks and broken backlinks, new and lost month by month, and the link gap: sites that link to your Google competitors and not to you.

tools.name: get_seo_fixes
tools.description: The SEO fixes Goppa prepared for your pages (titles, meta descriptions, image text): the ones waiting for your approval with the current and proposed text, the ones applied on your site, and the product questions. Read-only: approving happens in Goppa.

tools.name: run_site_check
tools.description: Run a new AI readability check on one of your sites now and save it to your Goppa account. It reads your public pages; nothing on your site changes. Up to 10 per hour per account.

tools.name: add_site
tools.description: Add one of your websites to your Goppa account, so Goppa can check, measure and track it. It counts toward the sites your account includes. Goppa reads the site's home page to see its platform; nothing on the site changes. Adding a site that is already in the account changes nothing.

tools.name: run_ai_measurement
tools.description: Measure whether AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overview, Google AI Mode, Perplexity) name one of your sites, with real answers. Called without approval it returns a preview that runs nothing: the questions, the market, the engines and an approval code. Show the questions to the user and c

tools.name: get_fixes_to_apply
tools.description: The SEO fixes the user already approved in Goppa for one site, ready to apply on the site with the tools you have there (the site's code, its builder or its own app): the page, the field (title, meta description, image alt text), where it goes, the current text and the new text, exactly, and an llms

tools.name: report_fixes_applied
tools.description: Record in Goppa which approved SEO fixes from get_fixes_to_apply were applied on the site (applied), could not be applied (not_applied, with a reason), or were undone (undone, kept). Goppa's next site audit then checks each page. It changes nothing on the site.

tools.name: scan_site
tools.description: Score any website 0-100 on how readable it is to AI assistants: crawler access, structured data, discovery files and agent protocols. Returns the score and the failing checks. Public information only, no account needed.

tools.name: get_study
tools.description: Return findings from Goppa's 2026 Q3 study of 176 businesses that already rank on page one of Google: how many returned nothing to an identified crawler, which checks fail most, and how technical readiness related to being mentioned by AI assistants.
